plain: An officer who carries the mace, the symbol of a body's authority.

webster.text: A person who carries a mace before men in authority.

example.quote: Chief Justice must give way ; our mace-bearer is no match for a regiment." It was inhuman to place an individual against a whole regiment.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
